methods.formula: Value = (assets in place + C − net debt) ÷ shares;  C = S·N(d₁) − K·e^(−rT)·N(d₂), d₁ = [ln(S ÷ K) + (r + σ²/2)T] ÷ σ√T, d₂ = d₁ − σ√T

K = capital to build it: $1.48B ÷ sales-to-capital 0.53 = $2.80B
σ = 78% (its stock, a year of daily closes), T = 5 years, r = 4.91% → C = $4.18B
assets in place = NOPAT $0 ÷ WACC = $0; value = ($0 + $4.18B − net debt $2.48B) ÷ 595,470,000 = $2.84
